headline: Gentle AI can review this change before you call it done.
reason: Review can help detect regressions in these changes.
value: Reviewing takes a little longer and makes the result safer.
risk_evidence: this change is not purely passive documentation, so it gets one consolidated review.

choices.label: Review this change
choices.effect: Reviews only this change; later medium- or high-risk changes ask again, and delivery needs separate approval.

choices.label: Skip this time
choices.effect: Skips only this change; no review record is created, and future reviews stay enabled.
